fields.PRODUCT NAME: Handcrafted Wooden Tea Coaster Set with Colourful Floral Art
fields.DESCRIPTION: Add a touch of Rajasthani charm to your table with this handcrafted wooden tea coaster set. Each coaster is beautifully adorned with vibrant floral artwork in bright yellow, blue, green, and red hues, reflecting the lively spirit of Rajasthan. The sturdy wooden holder, decorated with traditional hand-painted motifs, keeps the coasters neatly arranged and doubles as a charming décor piece. Perfect for serving tea or coffee, this coaster set combines functionality with folk artistry, making it an ideal addition to your home or a thoughtful gift for loved ones.
